markdown.markdown:
```{r} library(kableExtra) library(glue) library(here) library(tidyverse) here("scripts/functions.R") %>% source() high_nests <- here("data", "field_data.rds") %>% read_rds() %>% pluck("nests") %>% filter(height > 2) %>% pull(nest_id) %>% str_c(collapse = "|") %>% str_c("(", ., ")") next_nest_checks <- here("data", "temp_nest_checking.rds") %>% read_rds() %>% # Add emoji for selfie-stick nests: mutate( check_nests = str_replace_all( check_nests, high_nests, "\\1 \U1F992" ) ) next_pred_cam_maintenance <- here("data", "predator_camera_maintenance.rds") %>% read_rds() %>% mutate( patch, date = next_maintenance, camera_id = str_extract_all(camera_id, "[0-2]$"), .keep = "none" ) %>% summarize( predator_cameras = str_flatten(camera_id, collapse = ", "), .by = !camera_id ) schedule <- here("data", "season_schedule.rds") %>% read_rds() %>% unnest(patch_counts) %>% unnest(boards) %>% filter( week == week( today() + 1 ) - 19, ) %>% summarize( boards = str_flatten(board_id, collapse = ", "), .by = !board_id ) %>% left_join( next_nest_checks, by = join_by(date == date, patch_count == patch) ) %>% left_join( next_pred_cam_maintenance, by = join_by(date, patch_count == patch) ) %>% mutate( departure_time = ( hm(arrive) - minutes(45) ) %>% hms::hms() %>% as.character() %>% str_remove(":00$"), across( check_nests:predator_cameras, ~ replace_na(.x, "-") ) ) schedule_list <- schedule %>% split(schedule$day) day_level_data <- schedule_list %>% map( ~ .x %>% select( date, arrive:helper ) %>% distinct() %>% mutate( date_pretty = make_pretty_dates(date) ) ) # custom functions -------------------------------------------------------- my_kable_style <- function(.kable) { .kable %>% kable_styling( bootstrap_options = c( "striped", "hover", "condensed" ), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 28 ) } # Departure, arrival, and sunrise table: morning_times <- function(.day) { schedule_list %>% pluck(.day) %>% distinct( "Departure" = departure_time, "Arrival" = arrive, "Sunrise" = sunrise ) %>% kable( format = "html", align = c("c", "c", "c") ) %>% my_kable_style() %>% column_spec(1:3, width = "14.5em") } # Format point counts and coverboards for a given day: pred_counts <- function(.day) { schedule_list %>% pluck(.day) %>% mutate( Patch = patch_count, Time = str_c(date, sunrise) %>% { ymd_hm(.) + minutes(40 * (patch_order - 1)) } %>% format("%H:%M") ) %>% select( Time, Patch = patch_count, Coverboards = boards, `Check nests` = check_nests, `Predator cameras` = predator_cameras ) %>% kable( format = "html", align = c( "c", "l", "c", "l" ) ) %>% my_kable_style() } # Nest searching order: nest_searching_order <- function( .day, .ordered = TRUE, .patches ) { if(.ordered) { schedule_list %>% pluck(.day) %>% filter(patch_order != 1) %>% arrange( desc(patch_order) ) %>% pull(patch_count) %>% str_flatten(collapse = " \u2192 ") } else { .patches %>% str_flatten(collapse = " \u2192 ") } } # Nest searching activity details: nest_searching <- function( .day = "Tue", .ordered = TRUE, .helper, .patches, .helper_patch_1 = "-", .me_patch_1 = "-", .helper_patch_2 = "-", .me_patch_2 = "-" ) { if(.ordered) { start <- schedule_list %>% pluck(.day) %>% filter(patch_order != 1) %>% arrange( desc(patch_order) ) %>% select(helper, patch_count) %>% mutate( patch_count = factor( patch_count, levels = patch_count ) ) } else { start <- tibble( helper = .helper, patch_count = .patches ) %>% mutate( patch_count = factor( patch_count, levels = patch_count ) ) } crossing( Patch = start$patch_count, Person = c( "TNS", pull(start, unique(helper)) ) ) %>% mutate( Activities = c( .helper_patch_1, .me_patch_1, .helper_patch_2, .me_patch_2 ) ) %>% filter( Person != "-" ) %>% kable(format = "html") %>% # my_kable_style() %>% collapse_rows( columns = 1 ) } ``` # Weekly schedule: `r pretty_date_range(schedule)`
::: panel ::: summary_box *Helper: `r unique(schedule_list$Mon$helper)`* ```{r} morning_times(.day = "Mon") ``` ::: **Point count times, coverboards, and nests to check**: ```{r} pred_counts(.day = "Mon") ``` **Nest searching**: `r nest_searching_order(.day = "Mon")` ```{r} nest_searching( .day = "Mon", .me_patch_1 = "Continue path down the Western edge; Create distributaries from the central N-S path", .me_patch_2 = "Search near CB 1 and 2 -- carve paths where necessary", # If schedule changes: # .ordered = FALSE, # .patches = c("", ""), # .helper = "", # .helper_patch_1 = "-", # .helper_patch_2 = "-" ) ``` Other to-dos: * GPS the path at coyote from CB 4 to CB 5. * Grab extra poles from grassland_a and the old forest_b. ::: ::: panel ::: summary_box *Helper: `r unique(schedule_list$Tue$helper)`* ```{r} morning_times(.day = "Tue") ``` ::: **Point count times, coverboards, and nests to check**: ```{r} pred_counts(.day = "Tue") ``` **Nest searching**: `r nest_searching_order(.day = "Tue")` ```{r} nest_searching( .day = "Tue", .helper_patch_1 = "-", .me_patch_1 = "-", .helper_patch_2 = "-", .me_patch_2 = "-", # If schedule changes: # .ordered = FALSE, # .helper = "", # .patches = c("", "") ) ``` ::: ::: panel ::: summary_box *Helper: `r unique(schedule_list$Wed$helper)`* ```{r} morning_times(.day = "Wed") ``` ::: **Point count times, coverboards, and nests to check**: *BSE: Machete a trail at firehouse that connects trailcam_1 and the northwest passage. There is a fence near trailcam_1 that can be navigated around, but bring boltcutters just in case.* ```{r} pred_counts(.day = "Wed") ``` **Nest searching**: `r nest_searching_order(.day = "Wed")` ```{r} nest_searching( .day = "Wed", .me_patch_1 = "-", .me_patch_2 = "-", # If schedule changes: # .ordered = FALSE, # .patches = c("", ""), .helper = "BSE", .helper_patch_1 = "-", .helper_patch_2 = "-" ) ``` ::: ::: panel ::: summary_box *Helper: `r unique(schedule_list$Thu$helper)`* ```{r} morning_times(.day = "Thu") ``` ::: **Point count times, coverboards, and nests to check**: ```{r} pred_counts(.day = "Thu") ``` *Note: Install trailcam_2 at witch_hazel.* **Nest searching**: `r nest_searching_order(.day = "Thu")` ```{r} nest_searching( .day = "Thu", .helper_patch_1 = "-", .me_patch_1 = "-", .helper_patch_2 = "-", .me_patch_2 = "-", # If schedule changes: # .ordered = FALSE, # .helper = "", # .patches = c("", "") ) ``` *Note: There is an active nest right along the power line alley walkway at firehouse... be very careful when traversing through that area!* ::: ::: panel ::: summary_box *Helper: BSE* ```{r} morning_times(.day = "Fri") ``` ::: **Point count times, coverboards, and nests to check**: ```{r} pred_counts(.day = "Fri") ``` *BSE: Complete the circle at grassland_b during morning sampling. Then extend a path from the circle to the Southern end of the patch.* **Nest searching**: `r nest_searching_order(.day = "Fri")` ```{r} nest_searching( .day = "Fri", .me_patch_1 = "Search the CB 6 end of the patch and create distributaries from the main path", .me_patch_2 = "Continue path from the South end of the patch to the trailcam_0 trail; Create distributaries along the main paths", # If schedule changes: .ordered = FALSE, .patches = c("grassland_a", "grassland_b_fence"), .helper = "BSE", .helper_patch_1 = "Connector trail from CB 1 to the trailcam_1 path", .helper_patch_2 = "Extend the main cross-path patch further NE (starting at the path that begins between CB 4 and 5)" ) ``` Notes: * At each nest, take a picture from further away and jot down a brief description of where the picture was taken and how to find the nest. * Install metal boxes at trailcam_0 in each patch ::: ::: panel ::: summary_box *Helper: -* ```{r} morning_times(.day = "Sat") ``` ::: **Point count times, coverboards, and nests to check**: ```{r} pred_counts(.day = "Sat") ``` **Nest searching**: `r nest_searching_order(.day = "Sat")` ```{r} nest_searching( .day = "Sat", # .helper_patch_1 = "-", .me_patch_1 = "Pocket along entrace path", # .helper_patch_2 = "-", .me_patch_2 = "Line of trees at the Southern end of the patch", # If schedule changes: .ordered = FALSE, .helper = "-", .patches = c("leech", "grassland_b") ) ``` *Note: There are two active nest in the Southern portion of grassland_b... be very careful when traversing (or macheteing) through that area!* :::
